info.name: AdvisorAI API
info.description:
AI-Powered Knowledge Base & Auto Advisor for SMEs.

## Features
- **Document Management** — upload, classify, version-control business documents
- **AI Knowledge Extraction** — extract obligations, deadlines, risks, metrics
- **Semantic Search** — query your knowledge base with natural language
- **Conversational Chatbot** — multi-turn AI advisor with session history
- **Compliance Engine** — country-specific rules, gap analysis, score tracking
- **Analytics & Export** — dashboards, PDF/Excel reports
- **Integrations** — webhooks, accounting/HR/ERP connectors

## Authentication
All endpoints (except `/health` and `/auth/*`) require a Bearer JWT token.
Obtain tokens via `POST /api/v1/auth/login`.

request.description:
Generate a password-reset token and (in production) email it to the user.
Always returns 200 so as not to leak whether the email exists.

Upload a PDF, DOCX, XLSX, DOC, XLS, or TXT file for AI processing. If a document with the same filename already exists for this company, the new upload is stored as the next version and the previous document's ID is recorded in `doc_metadata.previous_version_id`. Processing (text extraction, embedding, knowledge extraction) is triggered asynchronously.

Upload up to 20 files in a single request. Each file is validated and processed independently. Versioning applies per file just as with single upload. Returns a summary with counts of uploaded and failed files, plus the list of DocumentResponse objects for successfully created records.

Semantic search over both documents and knowledge entries using pgvector.
Returns the most relevant matches ranked by cosine similarity.

Server-Sent Events streaming endpoint.
    Client receives tokens one-by-one as `data: <token>

` lines.
    Final event is `data: [DONE]

`.

Store thumbs-up (rating=1) or thumbs-down (rating=-1) feedback on an AI-generated message. An optional free-text comment can be included. Feedback is persisted in the message's sources field alongside the original source citations.
Synchronously generate and stream a PDF or Excel report.

request.description:
Train the predictive risk scorer with labelled data.
If no payload.training_data is provided, build a dataset from existing
KnowledgeEntry records with risk_level set for the current company.

Quick status endpoint to let the UI show which LLM backend is active
and whether credentials are missing.

Aggregate business health score based on:
- Document coverage (how many docs are processed)
- Compliance posture (from compliance rules)
- AI advisor usage (engagement)
- Expiry risk (docs expiring soon penalise score)

Returns upcoming compliance deadlines for the next N months.
Combines statutory recurring events with company-specific document deadlines.

Returns documents that are expiring soon based on metadata.expiry_date.
Also flags documents older than 1 year with no renewal record.

Full-text keyword search across documents and knowledge entries.
Results are scoped to the authenticated user's company and ranked by relevance.
